shouldFix.title: G01/G02 silently choose a binary-byte meaning for D-006's undefined MB unit, and G02 still leaves installed-tree byte accounting open
shouldFix.detail: D-006 decides G01 at 25 MB, G02 at 80 MB, and G04 at 40/50/60/100 MB, but nowhere defines MB as 1,000,000 bytes or 1,048,576 bytes. The subject nevertheless turns G01 into 26,214,400 bytes and G02 into 83,886,080 bytes, values found in neither D-006, D-102, nor file 08. That is the IEC-style multiplication while retaining the SI symbol MB. The distinction changes outcomes: a 25,500,000-byte compressed artifact exceeds 25 decimal MB but passes the subject's G01 comparison; an 81,000,000-byte tree likewise exceeds 80 decimal MB but passes its G02 comparison. The subject does not apply the same conversion discipline to G04. Separately, 'installed-tree size in bytes' never fixes whether G02 sums logical file lengths, allocated blocks, metadata/xattrs, links, or deduplicated inventory nodes, so even a chosen unit would not produce one reproducible value. D-102 demonstrates that this corpus states unit conversions explicitly when intended by defining GiB as bytes/1024^3; no comparable D-006 rule exists here.
shouldFix.impact: Two conforming implementations can disagree on G01/G02/G04 pass/fail while both claim to implement D-006. The exact-byte harness candidate therefore adds an unreviewed threshold interpretation and cannot close OBL-2 as written.
shouldFix.requiredRepair: Route one reviewed D-006 unit/accounting clarification that preserves the adopted 25/80/40/50/60/100 numerals while defining the byte unit consistently for G01, G02, and G04. Define G02's installed-tree accounting domain and link/metadata/allocation treatment. Then reproduce only the resulting authorized arithmetic in the parent and thin extractions. If no successor decides those semantics, remove the invented byte constants and keep OBL-2 open. Do not execute a harness or choose a new threshold numeral.

shouldFix.title: G03's no-load half and G04's RSS quantities are labels, not closed measurement protocols
shouldFix.detail: D-102 fully governs fleet labels, N=21, ranks, cold/warm ordering, path identity, native-architecture preflight, and paired regression. It does not define a non-vacuous component/project-load fixture or an RSS observation method, and the subject does not supply either missing layer. G03 merely asks for a 'process/module trace proving no component or project load' without pinning a valid discoverable component, a valid project, cwd/environment/discovery inputs, the observed event classes, or the classification/refusal rule. Running --help/--version where no component or project exists therefore passes vacuously. G04 asks for steady and peak traces plus a 'raw methodology record' but never defines steady-state window, peak sampling, OS primitive, child/process-tree scope, page/accounting convention, or byte-unit conversion. Recording whichever methodology an executor chose is disclosure, not a specification of the quantity whose every sample must satisfy D-006.
shouldFix.impact: The timing half can follow D-102, but the no-load and RSS halves admit mutually incompatible passing harnesses. A trace can be non-falsifying by construction, and the same process can yield different steady/peak values under different lawful sampling choices. Thus G03/G04 are not independently executable specifications and OBL-2 remains partly design-open.
shouldFix.requiredRepair: For G03, pin a non-vacuous available-component and project fixture, initial cwd/environment/discovery state, retained event stream, and closed rule that distinguishes access/load/spawn from mere availability. For G04, specify the per-platform RSS primitive, process scope, sample timing/window, steady and peak derivations, unit conversion, and retained raw observations while preserving D-102's N=21/order/preflight contract and D-006's exclusions. Do not run the fixture, change the D-102 fleet, or add analyze/consented-probe bounds.

shouldFix.title: G05 makes publication mandatory but never defines comparable start/RSS deltas
shouldFix.detail: D-006 intentionally requires per-component download/install/start/RSS visibility and defers numeric caps. The subject correctly invents no cap, but its only semantic requirement is four published numbers 'each with methodology and the core baseline they subtract from.' It does not identify the component-enabled workload, the paired core-only workload, start endpoints, RSS scope/quantity, repetition/aggregation, or the subtraction formula. The cited G03/G04 core baselines are --help/--version and doctor-read-only measurements; they are not a comparable TypeScript-provider start or RSS workload, and analyze RSS is expressly outside D-006/G04. Because the candidate accepts any disclosed methodology, publishers can report incomparable values or choose a baseline that makes the delta arbitrary while still passing the absence-only rule.
shouldFix.impact: G05 visibility is nominal rather than independently verifiable. The gate cannot establish that each component cost is independently visible, so its specification is not authored strongly enough to close OBL-2 even though no cap is required.
shouldFix.requiredRepair: Define a digest-pinned paired core-only versus component-enabled workload for start and RSS, exact start endpoints, RSS process/quantity semantics, sample/aggregate rule, and delta formula; bind each published delta to those inputs and raw observations. Keep download/install byte deltas exact and per platform. Preserve the no-cap standing and keep this G05 workload separate from D-006's deliberate exclusion of analyze and consented-probe RSS from G04. Do not choose a cap or execute the harness.

summary: REJECT at 0 blockers and 3 SHOULD-FIX. Custody, scope, naming, owner, fleet, non-execution, and readiness boundaries are sound: the subject is CANDIDATE-NOT-APPLIED, binds NOTHING, uses exactly G01-G05 and their five live owners, preserves all four D-002 platforms, delegates the G03/G04 machine protocol to the exact D-102 pin, forbids Rosetta, leaves required-now at 26, and leaves OD-101-1/OD-101-2 open without minting Rust-as-core. The five mode-0444 thin extractions exactly equal their parent harness objects and pin the parent digest. The candidate nevertheless does not yet author deterministic harness specifications. It silently interprets D-006 MB values as binary-byte constants for G01/G02 while D-006 makes no such unit decision and leaves G02 tree accounting undefined; it leaves G03 no-load and G04 RSS observation semantics open; and it lets G05 publishers choose arbitrary start/RSS workloads and delta methods. Those gaps affect pass/fail or comparability, so OBL-2 cannot be recorded closed on these bytes. No harness was executed and no subject, source, row, gate, threshold, cap, machine, open decision, file-08 cell, COORD entry, D9 code, section-7.1 recipe, or implementation authority was changed by this review.
